actions.addRecord.description: Create a user, group, group member, organizational unit or role assignment
actions.addRecord.props.parent.descripti: Only for **Group member**: the group e-mail or id.
actions.addRecord.props.record.descripti: Optional. Any other field in the Directory API shape of the resource type (camelCase); the Fields above win on conflicts. Examples: **User**: `{"primaryEmail":"jane.doe@example.com","name":{"givenName":"Jane","familyName":"Doe"},"password":"a-temporary-password","changePasswordAtNextLogin":true,"orgUnitPath":"/"}` · **Group**: `{"email":"sales@example.com","name":"Sales","description":"Sales team"}` · **Group member**: `{"email":"jane.doe@example.com","role":"MEMBER"}` · **Organizational unit**: `{"name":"West","parentOrgUnitPath":"/Sales","description":"West coast sales"}` · **Role assignment**: `{"roleId":"12345678901234567","assignedTo":"1122334455667788990","scopeType":"CUSTOMER"}`
actions.addRecord.props.recordFields.des: The fields of the new record. They change with the Resource Type.
actions.addRecord.props.resourceType.des: Which kind of record. Only the types this action supports are listed.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Call any Admin SDK endpoint. Paths are relative to https://admin.googleapis.com, e.g. /admin/directory/v1/users?customer=my_customer, /admin/reports/v1/activity/users/all/applications/login, /admin/datatransfer/v1/applications.
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.deleteRecord.description: Remove a user, group, group member, organizational unit, mobile device or role assignment. Deleted users can be restored for 20 days from the Admin console; everything else is permanent.
actions.deleteRecord.props.identifier.de: **User**: primary e-mail, alias or user id · **Group**: group e-mail, alias or group id · **Group member**: member e-mail or id · **Organizational unit**: org unit path (e.g. /Sales/West) or `id:<orgUnitId>` · **Mobile device**: device resource id · **Chrome OS device**: device id · **Role assignment**: role assignment id
actions.deleteRecord.props.parent.descri: Only for **Group member**: the group e-mail or id.
Which kind of record. Only the types this action supports are listed.
actions.getRecord.description: Return the full record of a user, group, group member, org unit, device or role assignment
actions.getRecord.props.identifier.descr: **User**: primary e-mail, alias or user id · **Group**: group e-mail, alias or group id · **Group member**: member e-mail or id · **Organizational unit**: org unit path (e.g. /Sales/West) or `id:<orgUnitId>` · **Mobile device**: device resource id · **Chrome OS device**: device id · **Role assignment**: role assignment id
actions.getRecord.props.params.descripti: Optional Directory API parameters for this collection, e.g. `projection: full` and `customFieldMask: Schema1` for users, `viewType: domain_public`.
actions.getRecord.props.parent.descripti: Only for **Group member**: the group e-mail or id.
actions.getRecord.props.resourceType.des: Which kind of record. Only the types this action supports are listed.
actions.mobileDeviceAction.description: Approve, block or wipe a managed mobile device
Wipes cannot be undone once the device receives them.
Wipe account (remove the Workspace account from the device)
actions.mobileDeviceAction.props.resourc: The `resourceId` of the mobile device (from Search Records with type Mobile device).
actions.searchRecords.description: List records of one type with the Directory search syntax and pagination
actions.searchRecords.props.domain.descr: Only users and groups: restrict to one domain of the account (default: every domain of the customer).
actions.searchRecords.props.fetchAllPage: Follow the pagination until the list is exhausted (up to Max Rows). Off: return one page and its next page token.
actions.searchRecords.props.maxRows.desc: With "Fetch All Pages": stop after this many records (default 500, at most 10000). Without it: the page size (Google caps it per collection); organizational units have no paging, so extra rows are dropped and Truncated is set.
actions.searchRecords.props.pageToken.de: Only without "Fetch All Pages": the `nextPageToken` of a previous run to continue from.
actions.searchRecords.props.params.descr: **User**: orderBy, sortOrder, projection, customFieldMask, showDeleted, viewType · **Group**: orderBy, sortOrder, userKey · **Group member**: roles, includeDerivedMembership · **Organizational unit**: orgUnitPath, type · **Mobile device**: orderBy, sortOrder, projection · **Chrome OS device**: orgUnitPath, orderBy, sortOrder, projection, includeChildOrgunits · **Role assignment**: roleId, userKey, includeIndirectRoleAssignments
actions.searchRecords.props.parent.descr: Only for **Group member**: the group e-mail or id.
actions.searchRecords.props.query.descri: Directory search syntax (only for User, Group, Mobile device, Chrome OS device). Examples: `email:sales*` · `orgUnitPath=/Sales isSuspended=false` · `name:'Jane Doe'` · `manager='boss@example.com'`. Leave empty to list everything.
actions.searchRecords.props.resourceType: Which kind of record. Only the types this action supports are listed.
actions.suspendUser.description: Suspend a directory user (blocks sign-in, keeps data), or lift the suspension
actions.suspendUser.props.suspended.desc: On: suspend the user. Off: reactivate a suspended user.
actions.suspendUser.props.userKey.descri: Primary e-mail, alias or id of the user.
actions.transferData.description: Transfer a user's application data (Drive files, Calendar events, ...) to another user, e.g. when offboarding
actions.transferData.props.applicationId: Which application's data to transfer. The label lists the parameters the application accepts.
actions.transferData.props.newOwner.desc: E-mail or id of the user receiving the data.
actions.transferData.props.oldOwner.desc: E-mail or id of the user whose data moves. The user must still exist (suspended is fine).
actions.transferData.props.transferParam: Parameter key to value(s), comma-separated for several. Drive: `PRIVACY_LEVEL` = `SHARED,PRIVATE` (which files); Calendar: `RELEASE_RESOURCES` = `TRUE` (free the old owner's rooms/resources). Leave empty for the application's default.
actions.transferData.props.waitForComple: Poll the transfer for up to 120 seconds and return its final status; the step fails if it is still running by then or did not complete. Off: return right after Google accepts it.
actions.updateRecord.description: Change fields of a user, group, group member, organizational unit or Chrome OS device (PATCH: untouched fields stay as they are)
actions.updateRecord.props.identifier.de: **User**: primary e-mail, alias or user id · **Group**: group e-mail, alias or group id · **Group member**: member e-mail or id · **Organizational unit**: org unit path (e.g. /Sales/West) or `id:<orgUnitId>` · **Mobile device**: device resource id · **Chrome OS device**: device id · **Role assignment**: role assignment id
actions.updateRecord.props.parent.descri: Only for **Group member**: the group e-mail or id.
actions.updateRecord.props.record.descri: Optional. Any other field in the Directory API shape of the resource type (camelCase); the Fields above win on conflicts. Examples: **User**: `{"primaryEmail":"jane.doe@example.com","name":{"givenName":"Jane","familyName":"Doe"},"password":"a-temporary-password","changePasswordAtNextLogin":true,"orgUnitPath":"/"}` · **Group**: `{"email":"sales@example.com","name":"Sales","description":"Sales team"}` · **Group member**: `{"email":"jane.doe@example.com","role":"MEMBER"}` · **Organizational unit**: `{"name":"West","parentOrgUnitPath":"/Sales","description":"West coast sales"}` · **Role assignment**: `{"roleId":"12345678901234567","assignedTo":"1122334455667788990","scopeType":"CUSTOMER"}`
Only the fields you fill in are changed; empty fields keep their current value.

description: Manage Google Workspace users, groups, organizational units and devices, and react to Admin audit events.
triggers.newAdminActivityEvent.descripti: Fires when an administrator performs an action in the Admin console (audit log "admin"), in real time through a push notification
triggers.newAdminActivityEvent.props.eve: Only this admin audit event, e.g. `CREATE_USER`, `DELETE_USER`, `CHANGE_PASSWORD`, `ADD_GROUP_MEMBER`, `CREATE_ORG_UNIT`, `CHANGE_APPLICATION_SETTING`. Leave empty for every admin event. Names: https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/reports/v1/appendix/activity/admin
triggers.newAdminActivityEvent.props.fil: Optional event-parameter conditions, comma-separated, in the Reports API `filters` syntax, e.g. `USER_EMAIL==jane@example.com` or `ORG_UNIT_NAME==Sales`.
triggers.newApplicationActivityEvent.des: Fires on an audit event of a Google Workspace application (Drive, Login, Calendar, Groups, Mobile, ...), in real time through a push notification
triggers.newApplicationActivityEvent.pro: Only this event of the application, e.g. `login_success` (Login), `download` / `create` / `edit` (Drive), `change_calendar_acls` (Calendar), `DEVICE_REGISTER_UNREGISTER_EVENT` (Mobile). Leave empty for every event. Names per application: https://developers.google.com/workspace/admin/reports/v1/appendix
Optional event-parameter conditions, comma-separated, in the Reports API `filters` syntax, e.g. `doc_type==spreadsheet` or `login_type==google_password`.
triggers.newUserEvent.description: Fires when a user is created, deleted, suspended, undeleted, promoted/demoted as admin or otherwise changed, in real time through a push notification
triggers.newUserEvent.props.domain.descr: Only users of this domain (e.g. `example.com`). Leave empty for every domain of the account.
triggers.newUserEvent.props.kinds.descri: Which lifecycle events to fire on.
